scope: Statecraft only; latest usable generated mesh families and complete GLB-stage audit. No Weedbirds files.
binary_policy: Plain git follows existing repository; no LFS rules. Runtime FBXs +512px colour +owned material/prefab/controller/provenance; no duplicate GLB, 4K master, .blend, archive, private photo or third-party historical reference images added. Source hashes establish lineage.
build_gate: Unity Collections CS7036 reproduced on unchanged base4d92aff9; see generated-1948-build-baseline.json. Not end-to-end player-ready.
